passages.title: Ps. 7:1–2
passages.text: Amid desperate circumstances, David express trust (**my God**, **refuge**).

passages.title: Ps. 7:6–11
passages.text: The singers see their requests as part of the larger picture: God is a **righteous judge** (v. 11 ), to whom all the **peoples** of mankind are accountable (vv. 7 , 8 ). In the Psalms, God is often described as “judging” on behalf of the innocent and oppressed.

notes.text: **Psalm** . The title of this individual lament from David refers to an otherwise unknown incident in his life when a man of Benjamin (the tribe of Saul) slandered David. The psalm enables those who have been unfairly criticized (vv. 3–5 ) and persecuted to call on God for help.
The Lord’s **righteousness** and his status as **the Most High** (see vv. 6–11 ) lead to thanksgiving and praise.
